content:
Alex Martinez: routing question: for Hosted API, should auto-fallback be model-variant only, region only, or both? we keep calling it FPE but want to make sure semantics are tight

Connor O'Brien: both, but with strong constraints. region fallback is the safer default. model-variant fallback only if compat set is exact (tools/json/ctxlen)

Priya Natarajan: +1. also need reason codes. i want to be able to answer support: "why did you switch me"

Aisha Rahman: careful w/ data residency. EU-only accounts cannot ever hop to us-east even if primary is on fire

Ben Carter: naming nit: can we avoid "failover" in docs? feels like infra. "graceful degrade router" / "fallback routing" seems clearer

Alex Martinez: ok. proposal: FPE triggers on (a) 5xx>1% 2m, (b) p95>2.5s 5m w util>90%, (c) manual degrade flag during incident

Connor O'Brien: works. also: pinned builds. if `model_version_pinned=true` then only region fallback, no variant

Priya Natarajan: pls add `router.fpe_activated{reason=...}` metric and trace span. i want dashboards

Aisha Rahman: + audit log / request header? maybe behind flag. some customers will freak out otherwise

Alex Martinez: ack. i'll capture in ADR + spec
